# Appturesque

> Appturesque is the public website for Appturesque AI App Lab, a small static site with a retro terminal aesthetic, cat mascot, and the slogan "We code, therefore we are."

Appturesque is a static HTML/CSS/JavaScript website. The public site is primarily a brand landing page, not a product documentation site or API reference.

## Primary Pages

- [Home](https://appturesque.com/): Landing page for Appturesque and the AI App Lab identity.
- [404](https://appturesque.com/404.html): Not-found page styled consistently with the main site.
- [500](https://appturesque.com/500.html): Server-error page styled consistently with the main site.

## Assets

- [Open Graph Image](https://appturesque.com/og-image.png): Social preview image for the site.
- [Site Icon](https://appturesque.com/icon-512.png): High-resolution site icon.

## Notes For Assistants

- Canonical brand name: Appturesque.
- Public subtitle: AI App Lab.
- Public slogan: We code, therefore we are.
- The 404 and 500 pages are decorative error pages and should not be interpreted as API or product documentation.
